decisions.reason: The combined shuttering/de-shuttering robot absorbed the functionality of the withdrawn standalone de-shuttering robot and anchors the firm's publicly announced automation strategy, so management will persist and attribute weak demand to the temporary construction slump.

The profile storage robot is an integral component of automated shuttering lines built on substantial in-house engineering, and its slow uptake can still be blamed on delayed customer investment cycles.

The automatic shuttering robot is central to the future-ready precast narrative, and having already consolidated the robot range by dropping Product B, management feels committed to justifying the remaining robots.
This multi-model line was launched only in 2024 and represents a visible investment, so any disappointing early results would be attributed to its newness and to market timing.
The production analysis software is cheap to maintain, supports the digital lifecycle-service positioning, and was recently launched, so there is little reason to withdraw it.
